details:
- CVE-2024-4853: limit the editcap chop memmove to the allocated buffer
  size
- CVE-2024-4855: avoid use-after-free of the initial DSBs in editcap
- CVE-2026-15167: ensure the DBS Etherwatch read buffer has slack to
  prevent a crash
- CVE-2026-5404: fix a stack buffer overflow when writing K12 source
  descriptor records
- CVE-2026-76920: bound the 3GPP log hex-data copy loop to prevent a
  one-byte heap buffer overflow
- CVE-2026-76926: report a malformed BUSMASTER header as a bad file
  instead of exiting the program
- CVE-2026-15164: cap ciscodump writes at PACKET_MAX_SIZE
- CVE-2026-7378: clear the sharkd filter table when loading a new file
- CVE-2026-6535: prevent integer overflows when sizing and accumulating
  the zlib decompression buffer
- CVE-2026-6868: stop reusing the X.25 conversation after dissecting IP
  so subdissectors do not read past a stack variable
- Add dissection recursion depth checks used by the fixes below
- CVE-2026-5401: limit recursion depth in AFP Spotlight query dissection
- CVE-2026-5406: limit FC-SWILS zone-object recursion depth
- CVE-2026-5408: limit BitTorrent DHT bencoded list/dict recursion depth
- CVE-2026-6538: prevent overflow and stack exhaustion in the BEEP
  dissector
- CVE-2026-6527: guard cyclic open-type dissection in generated ASN.1
  dissectors against unbounded recursion
- CVE-2026-5407: check for offset overflow in SMB2 EA info and notify
  data dissection
- CVE-2026-6867: bound total SMB2 chained compression to prevent a crash
- CVE-2026-5653: fix a heap buffer overflow in the ETSI DCP dissector
- CVE-2026-6530: require equal-size fragments for DCP ETSI Reed-Solomon
  reassembly
- CVE-2026-15172: do not precompute the FMP/NOTIFY handle list length to
  avoid an integer overflow
- CVE-2026-6520: add a length check for OpenFlow v6 OFPBPT_TIME to
  prevent an infinite loop
- CVE-2026-6521: prevent infinite loops in OpenFlow v5 action and table
  description dissection
- CVE-2026-6522: check for offset overflow on unknown RPKI-RTR PDU types
  to prevent an infinite loop
- CVE-2026-15163: advance dissection offsets in the MIH, MPEG DSM-CC,
  eDonkey and MEGACO dissectors to prevent infinite loops
- CVE-2026-15174: cap E-DCH DDI entries at MAX_EDCH_DDIS in the Catapult
  DCT2000 dissector
- CVE-2023-1992: bound RPCoRDMA global write offsets to prevent a
  dissector crash
- CVE-2023-1993: stop LISP LCAF dissection from reading past the payload
  length
- CVE-2023-1994: guard against a NULL pointer dereference in the GQUIC
  dissector
- CVE-2023-5371: reject RTPS offset additions that move the offset
  backwards to prevent an excessive dissection loop
- CVE-2026-15169: add channel and MAC-is SDU bounds checks in the UMTS
  FP dissector
- CVE-2025-11626: validate the Mongo message section size to avoid an
  infinite loop
- CVE-2026-6526: check the strstr() result when resolving HTTP Location
  targets to avoid a crash
- CVE-2026-6869: bound WebSocket permessage-deflate decompression buffer
  growth
- CVE-2026-6532: fix a heap buffer overflow in the Kismet dissector
- CVE-2026-6534: skip USB HID items with a report size of zero to
  prevent an infinite loop
- CVE-2023-0667: use the transcoded string length in MS-MMS column text
  to prevent a heap buffer over-read
- CVE-2026-6870: stop using a global tree pointer in the GSM RP
  dissector
